pattern: SELECT .+ FROM .+ WHERE dog_id IN \(\s*(SELECT dog_id FROM .+\s+JOIN\s+.+\s+ON\s+.+\s+GROUP BY dog_id HAVING SUM\(.+\)\s*<= \d+\s*\)
correction: REPLACE the condition (SUM(.+) <= \d+) with (NOT IN (SELECT dog_id FROM .+ GROUP BY dog_id HAVING SUM(.+) > \d+))

metadata.description: This rule corrects the error where a subquery is used incorrectly in the WHERE clause, leading to an inaccurate result. The error occurs when summing up values that should not be added together.
